scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:integration
scripts.test:k6-compat: docker compose --profile test-tools build k6-compat && docker compose --profile test-tools run --rm --no-deps k6-compat
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/test-environment-safety.test.mjs && pnpm test:scripts && turbo run test:unit
scripts.test:scripts: pnpm --filter @checkout-surge/contracts build && node --test scripts/env-utils.test.mjs scripts/maintenance-cleanup-runs.test.mjs scripts/run-in-compose.test.mjs scripts/runtime-image-contract.test.mjs scripts/runtime-recovery-soak.test.mjs scripts/runtime-smoke.test.mjs scripts/runtime-reset-client.test.mjs
scripts.test:characterization: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter web exec node ../../scripts/run-with-test-env.mjs vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/browser-workflows.test.ts && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs node scripts/composition-characterization.mjs
scripts.test:infra:up: node scripts/run-with-test-env.mjs docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait postgres-test redis-test
scripts.test:infra:down: node scripts/run-with-test-env.mjs docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down --volumes --remove-orphans
scripts.infra:up: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.infra:down: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml down postgres redis
scripts.runtime:up:debug: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build
scripts.runtime:setup: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs docker compose run --rm --build runtime-setup
scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && turbo run dev --filter api --filter worker --filter mock-erp --filter load-orchestrator --filter web
